overview_description.description: Allium provides blockchain data infrastructure for institutions and crypto-focused organizations. It collects, verifies, and standardizes data from more than 150 blockchains and thousands of protocols, making on-chain activity easier to analyze and use in operational workflows. The company delivers historical and real-time data through APIs, data streams, data shares, dashboards, and query tools. Its datasets support applications such as transaction reconciliation, analytics, compliance, payments, and digital asset research. Allium also offers tools for querying, visualizing, and accessing blockchain data to help organizations build applications and monitor activity across multiple blockchain networks.

product.name: Allium Explorer
product.description: A platform for cross-chain blockchain data exploration, offering querying, visualization, and API configuration in one interface.

product.name: Allium Developer
product.description: A set of low-latency APIs and custom workflows for building and scaling real-time blockchain applications across multiple chains.

product.name: Allium Datastreams
product.description: A service delivering real-time blockchain event data through enterprise message brokers like Kafka, Pub/Sub, and SNS.

product.name: Allium Datashares
product.description: Bulk delivery of blockchain data directly to customers' data lakes, enabling control over compute resources while maintaining query privacy.

product.name: Wallet360™
product.description: A dataset providing over 100 precomputed attributes for every wallet address, including activity, balances, and interactions with DEXs and NFT marketplaces.

product.name: Decoded Logs
product.description: A service that pre-decodes raw blockchain logs and traces into structured JSON parameters for easier analysis.
